cardOverview.overviewText: SBM (State Bank of Mauritius) has teamed up with KreditPe to provide customers with instant credit facilities for their purchases. This collaboration allows users to access quick and easy financing options through the KreditPe platform, enhancing the overall shopping and payment experience.
